title: Juicy Roasted Slovakian Chicken Pilaf
description: A hearty roasted chicken and rice dish inspired by Slovakian cuisine, perfect for a post-workout meal
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
In a large bowl, whisk together chicken broth, olive oil, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat and cook the chicken until browned
In a separate pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil and cook the basmati rice according to package instructions
In a large roasting pan, combine the cooked rice, onion, carrots, and peas
Add the cooked chicken to the roasting pan and stir to combine
Roast in the preheated oven for 25 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the top is crispy
